hero.titleLine1: Keep an eye on your heart
hero.subtitle: A wearable measures your heart rhythm continuously, the app nudges you when something looks off, and a cardiologist is one tap away.

about.title: A companion for your heart
about.p1: Many people never know their heart is out of rhythm until a complication appears. HealthSense exists so you do not have to wait for that moment: a familiar wearable becomes the friend who listens to your heartbeat every minute.
about.p2: Just wear it and live as usual. When something deserves attention, the app tells you in plain words and brings you to the right person to help.

continuous.title: Continuous
continuous.description: Measures day and night, nothing to switch on.

accuracy.title: Trustworthy
accuracy.description: Only nudges when it matters, fewer false alarms.

realtime.title: Instant
realtime.description: A sign shows up on your phone right away.

expertCare.title: Expert care
expertCare.description: Cardiologists review your results and advise you.

benefits.title: As simple as wearing a band
benefits.subtitle: HealthSense takes care of the complicated parts. You only see what matters.

monitor.title: 24/7 monitoring
monitor.description: The wearable records your heart rhythm continuously, even while you sleep, and syncs to the app.

alert.title: Early nudges
alert.description: Spots signs of atrial fibrillation and tells you what to do next.

doctor.title: Doctors on hand
doctor.description: Share your measurements, book a consultation and chat with a cardiologist in the app.

lifestyle.title: Food & lifestyle
lifestyle.description: Heart-friendly meal and habit suggestions, personalised for you.

how.title: Three steps, no tech talk
how.subtitle: Wear the band, open the app, and let HealthSense and your doctor handle the rest.

wear.title: Wear the band
wear.description: Wear the HealthSense band like a watch and pair it with your phone once.

watch.title: The app watches
watch.description: Your heart rhythm is monitored continuously; if something needs attention you get a notification.

care.title: A doctor advises
care.description: When needed, book and chat with a cardiologist who already has your measurements.

cara.title: Ask Cara anytime
cara.subtitle: Cara reads your own data to answer, points you to the right page and explains everything in plain words.

samples.consult: Do I have an upcoming consultation?
samples.navigate: Where do I change my password?

cara.note: Available in the corner of every page in the app.

cta.title: Start listening to your heart
cta.subtitle: Create a free account, connect your band and let HealthSense walk with you from today.

footer.description: HealthSense follows your heart rhythm every day, nudges you early when something looks off and connects you with cardiologists.
footer.disclaimer: Medical disclaimer: HealthSense is an experimental AI technology platform that supports heart rate monitoring and atrial fibrillation screening. Results are for reference only and do not replace a diagnosis by a physician. See the Terms of Use & Disclaimer for details.
